address: 2 Le Van Mien Street, An Khanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 71300, Vietnam
bio: In its new location and managed by a youthful, energetic team, Okra retains its cosy charm. The stylish bar facing an open kitchen is lined with counter seating for an immersive and relaxed dining experience. The chef crafts an unconventional menu from locally sourced ingredients, blending modern and traditional techniques inspired by chargrill and street food. Generous portions and a great selection of wines and cocktails make it a popular spot for relaxing....
